clue.text: Starting well? Start game without starter on the other side: cover with unobservable object

indicators.note: the quark is said to cover the rest, so the other pieces sit inside its letters

parts.note: a quark is a subatomic particle never observed on its own

indicators.note: the first letter of the phrase for starting a game is dropped

parts.note: to kick off is to start a football match
'them', as opposed to 'us', are the people on the other side

explanation.surface: A coach describes beginning a match from the far end of the pitch while hiding something unseen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the other side' sounds like a playing area but means 'them' versus 'us'; a quark, never seen alone, is the outer piece, split after its first two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone quick to respond or react is said to be fast from the starting line, i.e. off to a good beginning.

clue.text: Pretty little finish to the queen's little implement

parts.note: twee means pretty in a dainty, quaint way
Z is the last letter of the alphabet, so its finish
ER is the Queen (Elizabeth Regina); with 's it becomes ERS

explanation.surface: A dainty final touch is given to a small tool belonging to the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Tweezers are a small pincer-like tool for plucking hairs or handling tiny objects.

clue.text: See 24
Ulster actors depressed?

parts.note: County Down is one of the six counties of Northern Ireland, often called Ulster
the cast is the set of actors in a production

explanation.surface: Are the performers from Northern Ireland feeling low?
explanation.walkthrough: County Down is in Northern Ireland; read the question as asking whether the actors from there are glum.
explanation.definitionFit: Downcast is a standard synonym for gloomy or dejected in mood.

clue.text: Estate agent with cups and saucers

indicators.note: an agent causes change, so the letters of the preceding word are acted on and rearranged

explanation.surface: A property dealer arrives carrying crockery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Estate agent' reads as one profession, but 'agent' is the anagram signal working on ESTATE.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea service is a matched set of cups, saucers and pot for serving the drink.

clue.text: Wild bear has funny food

indicators.note: wild suggests the letters of the next word run out of control into a new order

parts.note: droll means amusing in a dry way

explanation.surface: An untamed bear is eating something comical.
explanation.definitionFit: A small loaf for one person is an everyday item of baked food.

clue.text: See 22
I'm all right, Jack, I'm using soft tissues

definitions.meaning: a phrase expressing selfish indifference to others' troubles
gentle tissues mean blowing does not chafe the nose's skin

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means a matter is of no concern to the speaker, just like the selfish catchphrase.

clue.text: It's upsetting me — clue now not wanted

indicators.note: upsetting the words knocks their letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A grumble that a puzzle hint is causing distress and is no longer needed.
explanation.definitionFit: An unwelcome guest or remark is one nobody desires or invited.

clue.text: Part of operation kept in proportion

indicators.note: only part of the word is used, a run of consecutive letters inside it

explanation.surface: A section of a procedure is kept in balance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'kept in' joins the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A ratio expresses the relative size of two quantities, a synonym of proportion.

clue.text: Appearance of V — between Guevara and Reagan?

definitions.text: Appearance of V — between Guevara and Reagan?

indicators.note: the letter is placed between the two names' short forms

parts.note: Che Guevara, the Argentine revolutionary
Ronald Reagan, US president, known as Ron

explanation.surface: Imagines a V-sign standing between a Marxist revolutionary and a Republican president.
explanation.definitionFit: A chevron is a V-shaped stripe or mark, as on a sergeant's sleeve.

clue.text: Fictional bear gets fish that's eaten half dish

indicators.note: the fish has eaten something, so the other piece goes inside it

parts.note: a shark is a fish

indicators.note: only the first half of the word is kept

explanation.surface: A storybook bear catches a fish that has already swallowed half the dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: Shardik is the giant bear in Richard Adams's 1974 novel of that name.

clue.text: Confide one's inner feelings to surgery

definitions.meaning: to ... one's ... is to share private emotions
... surgery is an operation with the chest cut ...

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both the idiom for baring one's emotions and the name of a type of cardiac operation.

clue.text: Mountain of stuff at the Cape

parts.note: matter is material, stuff
Cape Horn at the tip of South America

explanation.surface: A heap of material sits at the end of the continent.
explanation.definitionFit: The Matterhorn is a famous Alpine peak on the Swiss-Italian border.

clue.text: "Bedtime: that's all ____" — no love this time

indicators.note: no means without, so a letter is removed from the phrase

parts.note: the phrase completing the bedtime sign-off is 'for tonight'
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A parent's goodnight line, with no affection on this occasion.
explanation.walkthrough: Complete the quotation to get FOR TONIGHT, then remove one O.
explanation.definitionFit: A period of two weeks can be the time span meant; 'this time' points to a stretch of days.

clue.text: Extract from pool: if hurt, yell

indicators.note: hurt means damaged, so the two letters are knocked out of order

parts.note: to shout is to yell

explanation.surface: A swimmer injured in the pool cries out.
explanation.definitionFit: To fish something out is to retrieve it from water or a container.

clue.text: Something wrong about punishment being reversed in hotel

indicators.note: the whole assembly is read backwards
the flaw goes around the punishment

parts.note: a flaw is a defect
the rod, as in 'spare the rod', stands for punishment

explanation.surface: A complaint about discipline being overturned at a smart hotel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being reversed' turns the whole flaw-around-rod assembly backwards, not just the punishment it sits next to.
explanation.definitionFit: The Waldorf is a famous luxury hotel, the Waldorf Astoria in New York.

clue.text: Dead car: you must do it in 1 and 8

definitions.meaning: a vehicle declared beyond repair by insurers

definitions.text: you must do it in 1 and 8
definitions.meaning: both those long answers contain the letters O-F-F

explanation.definitionFit: A car damaged beyond economic repair is declared a total loss by the insurer.

clue.text: Neglect brings to naught travellers' task

parts.note: naught is zero, the letter O
a mission is a task for envoys or missionaries sent abroad

explanation.surface: Carelessness brings to nothing the job of a group on a journey.
explanation.definitionFit: An omission is something left undone, a failure to act, a form of neglect.

clue.text: Suggestion sibling should follow river through town in Kent

indicators.note: the sibling comes after the rest
the river runs through the town, so it goes inside

parts.note: Hythe is a coastal town in Kent, a county in south-east England
the Po is Italy's longest river
sis is short for sister

explanation.surface: A proposal that a sister trail a river through a Kentish town.
explanation.definitionFit: A hypothesis is a proposed explanation, a supposition put forward.

clue.text: Father's part of word

parts.note: pa is father; 's means has
a role is an actor's part

explanation.surface: A dad has a line in a play.
explanation.definitionFit: Parole originally meant a word of honour, a prisoner's promise.

clue.text: Motor concluding greening process

indicators.note: to process something is to work on it, so its letters are rearranged
only the concluding part of the word is used, its start dropped

explanation.surface: A machine is finishing an environmental makeover.
explanation.walkthrough: The concluding letters of 'greening' are EENING; 'process' rearranges them.
explanation.definitionFit: A motor is a machine that converts energy into motion.

clue.text: Clinging stuff, breeding ground for 10 and source of pictures

parts.note: cling film is plastic wrap
a stud is a place where horses are bred
IO looks like the number 10

explanation.surface: A list: plastic wrap, a farm, and somewhere that produces images.
explanation.definitionFit: A film studio is where films, moving pictures, are made.

clue.text: See 13
Bindweed beatified sailors' home among cat, horse (say) and parrot

indicators.note: the sailors' home is placed among the letters of the cat

parts.note: mog is slang for a cat
RN is the Royal Navy
in means at home

indicators.note: the letter G is said like 'gee', a call to a horse

parts.note: gee-gee is a child's word for a horse
a lory is a small parrot

explanation.surface: A climbing weed sent to heaven, with a naval home among the pets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beatified' points to GLORY as heaven's state; MO(RN IN)G gives MORNING.
explanation.definitionFit: Morning glory is a climbing plant of the bindweed family.

clue.text: One off reappearance of star writer named in 26 17 across

indicators.note: off means removed, so a letter comes out

parts.note: emersion is a star's reappearance after an eclipse
I is one in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A star comes back into view, minus one.
explanation.walkthrough: 26 and 17 across give RALPH WALDORF, close to Ralph Waldo Emerson.
explanation.definitionFit: Ralph Waldo Emerson was an American essayist and poet.

clue.text: Name for Kubla Khan's sacred one?

parts.note: the sacred river, R for river
in Coleridge's poem Kubla Khan, 'Alph, the sacred river, ran'

explanation.surface: A question about the Mongol emperor's holy river.
explanation.walkthrough: Coleridge's line 'Where Alph, the sacred river, ran' gives R(iver) Alph.
explanation.definitionFit: Ralph is a man's first name.

clue.text: Criminal loud in approaching bills

indicators.note: the loud letter goes inside the word for approaching

parts.note: near means approaching
f is forte, loud in music
IOUs are written promises to pay

explanation.surface: A villain in loud clothes approaches the invoices.
explanation.definitionFit: Nefarious means wicked or criminal.
